passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying. Tell those who prophesy out of their own imagination: Hear the word of the LORD!
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He said these words to me.
He called me “son of man.”
He told me to speak against the prophets of Israel.
These prophets were prophesying at that time.
He told me to speak to the prophets who speak from their own hearts.
He told me to say to them, “Hear the word of the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵ֛א אֶל־ נְבִיאֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַנִּבָּאִ֑ים וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לִנְבִיאֵ֣י מִלִּבָּ֔ם שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit, yet have seen nothing.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says, “Woe to the foolish prophets.
These prophets follow their own spirit.
They have seen nothing.”
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה ה֖וֹי עַל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֣ים הַנְּבָלִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹלְכִ֛ים אַחַ֥ר רוּחָ֖ם וּלְבִלְתִּ֥י רָאֽוּ׃

passages.text: Your prophets, O Israel, are like foxes among the ruins.
passages.sermon:
The prophets of Israel act like foxes.
They move among the ruins.
They do not help or protect.
They look for their own gain.
They do not rebuild or restore.

passages.text: You did not go up to the gaps or restore the wall around the house of Israel so that it would stand in the battle on the Day of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the prophets of Israel.
You did not go up to the broken places in the wall.
You did not repair the wall around the house of Israel.
You did not make Israel strong to stand in battle.
You did not prepare Israel for the Day of the LORD.
passages.original: לֹ֤א עֲלִיתֶם֙ בַּפְּרָצ֔וֹת וַתִּגְדְּר֥וּ גָדֵ֖ר עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַעֲמֹ֥ד בַּמִּלְחָמָ֖ה בְּי֥וֹם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: They see false visions and speak lying divinations. They claim, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ when the LORD did not send them; yet they wait for the fulfillment of their message.
passages.sermon:
False prophets in Israel see false visions.
They speak lying divinations.
They say, “Thus declares the LORD.”
The LORD did not send them.
They wait for their words to come true.
passages.original: חָ֤זוּ שָׁוְא֙ וְקֶ֣סֶם כָּזָ֔ב הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א שְׁלָחָ֑ם וְיִֽחֲל֖וּ לְקַיֵּ֥ם דָּבָֽר׃

passages.text: Haven’t you seen a false vision and spoken a lying divination when you proclaim, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ even though I have not spoken?
passages.sermon:
The prophets claim to speak for the LORD.
They say, “Thus declares the LORD.”
They see false visions.
They speak lying divinations.
The LORD has not spoken to them.
They say the LORD’s words, but He did not send them.
They declare messages that do not come from God.
passages.original: הֲל֤וֹא מַֽחֲזֵה־ שָׁוְא֙ חֲזִיתֶ֔ם וּמִקְסַ֥ם כָּזָ֖ב אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם וְאֹֽמְרִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וַאֲנִ֖י לֹ֥א דִבַּֽרְתִּי׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have uttered vain words and seen false visions, I am against you, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority.
He addresses false prophets.
These prophets speak empty words.
They see false visions.
The Lord GOD did not send them.
The Lord GOD says, "I am against you."
He declares His opposition clearly.
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן דַּבֶּרְכֶ֣ם שָׁ֔וְא וַחֲזִיתֶ֖ם כָּזָ֑ב לָכֵן֙ הִנְנִ֣י אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and speak lying divinations. They will not belong to the council of My people or be recorded in the register of the house of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is against certain prophets.
These prophets see false visions.
They speak lying divinations.
The Lord will act against them.
They will not join the council of His people.
Their names will not be written in the register of the house of Israel.
They will not enter the land of Israel.
People will know that He is the Lord GOD.
passages.original: וְהָיְתָ֣ה יָדִ֗י אֶֽל־ הַנְּבִיאִ֞ים הַחֹזִ֣ים שָׁוְא֮ וְהַקֹּסְמִ֣ים כָּזָב֒ בְּס֧וֹד עַמִּ֣י לֹֽא־ יִהְי֗וּ וּבִכְתָ֤ב בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹ֣א יִכָּתֵ֔בוּ וְאֶל־ אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑אוּ וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: Because they have led My people astray, saying, ‘Peace,’ when there is no peace, and whitewashing any flimsy wall that is built, tell those whitewashing the wall that it will fall. Rain will come in torrents, I will send hailstones plunging down, and a windstorm will burst forth.
passages.sermon:
False prophets led God’s people astray.
They said, “Peace.”
There was no peace.
Someone built a weak wall.
The false prophets covered the wall with whitewash.
God told Ezekiel to speak to those who whitewashed the wall.
He said, “The wall will fall.”
Heavy rain will pour down.
Hailstones will fall.
A strong wind will break the wall.
passages.original: יַ֣עַן וּבְיַ֜עַן הִטְע֧וּ אֶת־ עַמִּ֛י לֵאמֹ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם וְאֵ֣ין שָׁל֑וֹם וְהוּא֙ בֹּ֣נֶה חַ֔יִץ וְהִנָּ֛ם טָחִ֥ים אֹת֖וֹ תָּפֵֽל׃ אֱמֹ֛ר אֶל־ טָחֵ֥י תָפֵ֖ל וְיִפֹּ֑ל הָיָ֣ה׀ גֶּ֣שֶׁם שׁוֹטֵ֗ף וְאַתֵּ֜נָה אַבְנֵ֤י אֶלְגָּבִישׁ֙ תִּפֹּ֔לְנָה וְר֥וּחַ סְעָר֖וֹת תְּבַקֵּֽעַ׃

passages.text: Surely when the wall has fallen, you will not be asked, ‘Where is the whitewash with which you covered it?’
passages.sermon: The wall will fall.\r\nNo one will ask you, "Where is the whitewash you used?"
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֖ה נָפַ֣ל הַקִּ֑יר הֲלוֹא֙ יֵאָמֵ֣ר אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אַיֵּ֥ה הַטִּ֖יחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר טַחְתֶּֽם׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: In My wrath I will release a windstorm, and in My anger torrents of rain and hail will fall with destructive fury.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority.
The Lord GOD is angry.
The Lord GOD says, “I will act in My wrath.”
I will send a powerful windstorm.
This windstorm will show My anger.
I will send heavy rain in My fury.
I will send hailstones in My fierce anger.
These things will come with destructive force.
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וּבִקַּעְתִּ֥י רֽוּחַ־ סְעָר֖וֹת בַּֽחֲמָתִ֑י וְגֶ֤שֶׁם שֹׁטֵף֙ בְּאַפִּ֣י יִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְאַבְנֵ֥י אֶלְגָּבִ֖ישׁ בְּחֵמָ֥ה לְכָלָֽה׃

passages.text: I will tear down the wall you whitewashed and level it to the ground, so that its foundation is exposed. The city will fall, and you will be destroyed within it. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord God speaks with authority and power.
He will tear down the wall you covered with whitewash.
He will bring the wall down to the ground.
He will expose the foundation of the wall.
The wall will fall.
You will be destroyed inside the city.
You will know that the Lord is God.
passages.original: וְהָ֨רַסְתִּ֜י אֶת־ הַקִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר־ טַחְתֶּ֥ם תָּפֵ֛ל וְהִגַּעְתִּ֥יהוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְנִגְלָ֣ה יְסֹד֑וֹ וְנָֽפְלָה֙ וּכְלִיתֶ֣ם בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And after I have vented My wrath against the wall and against those who whitewashed it, I will say to you: ‘The wall is gone, and so are those who whitewashed it— those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw a vision of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Lord GOD.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says, “I will finish pouring out My anger on the wall.
I will also pour out My anger on those who covered it with whitewash.
Then I will say to you, ‘The wall is gone.
Those who whitewashed it are gone too.’
These people are the prophets of Israel.
They prophesied to Jerusalem.
They saw visions of peace for the city.
But there was no peace.
This is what the Lord GOD declares.”
passages.original: וְכִלֵּיתִ֤י אֶת־ חֲמָתִי֙ בַּקִּ֔יר וּבַטָּחִ֥ים אֹת֖וֹ תָּפֵ֑ל וְאֹמַ֤ר לָכֶם֙ אֵ֣ין הַקִּ֔יר וְאֵ֖ין הַטָּחִ֥ים אֹתֽוֹ׃ נְבִיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַֽנִבְּאִים֙ אֶל־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְהַחֹזִ֥ים לָ֖הּ חֲז֣וֹן שָׁלֹ֑ם וְאֵ֣ין שָׁלֹ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃פ

passages.text: Now, O son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own imagination. Prophesy against them and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: Woe to the women who sew magic charms on their wrists and make veils for the heads of people of every height, in order to ensnare their souls. Will you ensnare the souls of My people but preserve your own?
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
Ezekiel was a prophet among the exiles in Babylon.
God called Ezekiel “son of man.”
God told Ezekiel to face the daughters of his people.
These women claimed to be prophets.
They spoke messages from their own imagination.
God commanded Ezekiel to prophesy against these women.
God told Ezekiel to say, “This is what the Lord GOD says.”
God said, “Woe to the women who sew magic charms on their wrists.”
These women also make veils for the heads of people of every height.
They do this to ensnare souls.
They try to trap the souls of God’s people.
They try to keep their own souls alive.
God condemned their actions.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־ בְּנ֣וֹת עַמְּךָ֔ הַמִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וֹת מִֽלִּבְּהֶ֑ן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵיהֶֽן׃ וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הוֹי֩ לִֽמְתַפְּר֨וֹת כְּסָת֜וֹת עַ֣ל׀ כָּל־ אַצִּילֵ֣י יָדַ֗י וְעֹשׂ֧וֹת הַמִּסְפָּח֛וֹת עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ כָּל־ קוֹמָ֖ה לְצוֹדֵ֣ד נְפָשׁ֑וֹת הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ תְּצוֹדֵ֣דְנָה לְעַמִּ֔י וּנְפָשׁ֖וֹת לָכֶ֥נָה תְחַיֶּֽינָה׃

passages.text: You have profaned Me among My people for handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to My people who would listen, you have killed those who should not have died and spared those who should not have lived.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to false prophetesses in Israel.
These women act among His people.
They dishonor God.
They do this for small rewards.
They accept handfuls of barley.
They take scraps of bread.
They lie to God’s people.
God’s people listen to their lies.
These women cause death to innocent people.
They kill those who should not die.
They let the guilty live.
They spare those who should not live.
passages.original: וַתְּחַלֶּלְ֨נָה אֹתִ֜י אֶל־ עַמִּ֗י בְּשַׁעֲלֵ֣י שְׂעֹרִים֮ וּבִפְת֣וֹתֵי לֶחֶם֒ לְהָמִ֤ית נְפָשׁוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ תְמוּתֶ֔נָה וּלְחַיּ֥וֹת נְפָשׁ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ תִֽחְיֶ֑ינָה בְּכַ֨זֶּבְכֶ֔ם לְעַמִּ֖י שֹׁמְעֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: See, I am against the magic charms with which you ensnare souls like birds, and I will tear them from your arms. So I will free the souls you have ensnared like birds.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority.
He addresses women who use magic charms.
These women belong to the people of Israel.
They use these charms to trap souls.
They catch souls as if they are catching birds.
The Lord says He is against these magic charms.
He will tear the charms from their arms.
He will set free the souls they have trapped.
He will release the souls that were caught like birds.
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֤י אֶל־ כִּסְּתוֹתֵיכֶ֙נָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַ֠תֵּנָה מְצֹדְד֨וֹת שָׁ֤ם אֶת־ הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לְפֹ֣רְח֔וֹת וְקָרַעְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל זְרוֹעֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי֙ אֶת־ הַנְּפָשׁ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם מְצֹדְד֥וֹת אֶת־ נְפָשִׁ֖ים לְפֹרְחֹֽת׃

passages.text: I will also tear off your veils and deliver My people from your hands, so that they will no longer be prey in your hands. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is speaking to false prophetesses in Israel.
They have deceived God's people.
They have used magic and lies to ensnare souls.
The Lord says, "I will tear off your veils."
I will deliver My people from your hands.
My people will no longer be prey in your hands.
You will know that I am the LORD.
passages.original: וְקָרַעְתִּ֞י אֶת־ מִסְפְּחֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת־ עַמִּי֙ מִיֶּדְכֶ֔ן וְלֹֽא־ יִהְי֥וּ ע֛וֹד בְּיֶדְכֶ֖ן לִמְצוּדָ֑ה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Because you have disheartened the righteous with your lies, even though I have caused them no grief, and because you have encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways to save their lives, therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will deliver My people from your hands. Then you will know that I am the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord is speaking.
The Lord is just and true.
You have told lies.
Your lies have discouraged righteous people.
I, the Lord, did not cause the righteous any pain.
You have made the wicked feel strong.
You have encouraged the wicked to keep doing evil.
You have stopped them from turning away from their evil ways.
You have kept them from saving their lives.
Because of this, you will not see false visions anymore.
You will not practice divination anymore.
I, the Lord, will rescue my people from your power.
You will know that I am the Lord.
passages.original: יַ֣עַן הַכְא֤וֹת לֵב־ צַדִּיק֙ שֶׁ֔קֶר וַאֲנִ֖י לֹ֣א הִכְאַבְתִּ֑יו וּלְחַזֵּק֙ יְדֵ֣י רָשָׁ֔ע לְבִלְתִּי־ שׁ֛וּב מִדַּרְכּ֥וֹ הָרָ֖ע לְהַחֲיֹתֽוֹ׃ לָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֚וְא לֹ֣א תֶחֱזֶ֔ינָה וְקֶ֖סֶם לֹא־ תִקְסַ֣מְנָה ע֑וֹד וְהִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת־ עַמִּי֙ מִיֶּדְכֶ֔ן וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
